integrity: Exact conditional sampling kernel and analytical martingale limit proof; reproducibility code provides non-certifying finite checks. No claim of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Fixed integer k>=3, p in (0,1), finite initial hypergraph. No independent assessment, no normal approximation rate, no varying-parameter or non-singleton cluster limit. Results concern the stochastic hyperedge growth process with distinct non-repeated k-sets; early exhaustion uses a null-edge-step convention. Historical priority has residual risk.
title: A joint Gaussian law for isolated vertices in growing uniform hypergraphs
